candidates.name: Lord of the Craft
candidates.description: Lord of the Craft is an English-speaking medieval fantasy roleplay community on Minecraft Java Edition. Players create original characters, join nations and develop stories within a shared setting. Its published roleplay standards cover character conduct and collaborative storytelling, and new players complete a whitelist application before joining. Read the current rules and application guide on the official website. The displayed player count covers the advertised Minecraft network, including any lobby and other worlds.

candidates.name: Stoneworks
candidates.description: Stoneworks is an English-speaking Minecraft community built around player-created nations, diplomacy, warfare and worldbuilding. Players can establish governments, build settlements, trade and shape ongoing political stories. Its official introduction welcomes both casual and serious participants; PvP matters during wars, while professions, economy and roleplay offer other ways to take part. Follow the official website and Discord for current joining instructions and rules. The displayed count covers the advertised network, including its lobby and other worlds.

candidates.name: MassiveCraft
candidates.description: MassiveCraft is an English-speaking Minecraft Java community combining fantasy roleplay with factions survival. Its setting supports player groups, settlements, trade and shared stories, with guidance available through the community Discord. The official store describes roleplay and factions as the server focus and publishes its support policies. Check the community website and Discord for current joining requirements and client versions. The displayed player count covers the advertised network and may include survival, lobby or other activity beyond a specific RP scene.
